prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production battle background for the cute Japanese deckbuilding roguelike Bloom Spire
Primary request: a wide 16:9 lush hand-painted moonlit enchanted forest ruins background. Target 1920x1080 or closest wide 16:9 size.
Scene/backdrop: luminous cyan and teal glades, ancient stone ruins and an old stone path spanning the lower half, soft magenta flowers at the edges, cool moon glow in the center distance.
Style/medium: high quality detailed anime storybook painterly environment art, polished and richly atmospheric.
Composition/framing: create a clear open floor from x=20% to x=85% of the canvas for combat sprites. The open path should occupy the lower half. Tall forest and ruins frame the edges and upper scene.
Lighting/mood: magical moonlight, gentle luminous foliage, dreamy enchanted forest.
Constraints: environment only. No characters, creatures, text, lettering, logos, watermark, UI, card frames, or interface mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent character sprite atlas for the cute Japanese deckbuilding roguelike Bloom Spire
Primary request: one transparent PNG image, exact 4:3 aspect ratio, preferred 2048x1536. EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS BY 3 ROWS of equal-size square cells, twelve cells total. Each cell contains exactly one full-body character centered inside its own invisible square cell, with safe margins on every side. Native genuine transparent alpha background across all empty areas.
Style/medium: consistent cute polished 2.5-head chibi anime character art, delicate clean linework, beautiful soft painterly shading. Full figures, all limbs and accessories fully contained inside the assigned cells.
Layout row 1, left to right:
cell 0: pink-haired rabbit-eared female knight with a cream and red cape and a small sword, facing right in three-quarter view.
cell 1: silver and teal-haired fox-eared witch wearing a navy witch hat and holding a moon staff, facing right in three-quarter view.
cell 2: amber-haired cat-eared alchemist in a sage cloak holding a potion, facing right in three-quarter view.
cell 3: mint slime with a leaf sprout, facing left in three-quarter view.
Layout row 2, left to right:
cell 4: purple mushroom creature, facing left in three-quarter view.
cell 5: mischievous lavender bat, facing left in three-quarter view.
cell 6: round white floating ghost with pink cheeks, facing left in three-quarter view.
cell 7: armored walnut forest spirit with a spear, facing left in three-quarter view.
Layout row 3, left to right:
cell 8: teal tiny dragon, facing left in three-quarter view.
cell 9: regal crowned flower fairy boss in rose petals, facing left in three-quarter view.
cell 10: large lunar horned owl boss in silver and navy, facing left in three-quarter view.
cell 11: adorable but majestic dark purple crystal dragon boss, facing left in three-quarter view.
Constraints: EXACTLY twelve separate sprites in a perfectly regular four-column three-row atlas. Equal 512x512 cells at target size. All twelve sprites fully separated by transparent gaps and contained within their own cells. No borders, grid lines, labels, numbers, text, watermark, UI, ground, background scenery, opaque backing, colored backing, or checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha, no simulated transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production card illustration atlas for the cute Japanese deckbuilding roguelike Bloom Spire
Primary request: one image, exact 4:3 aspect ratio, preferred 2048x1536. EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS BY 3 ROWS, twelve equal-size square cells total. Each square cell is a separate full-bleed fantasy card illustration. Tiles meet exactly edge-to-edge with no gaps, frame, borders, text, numbers or labels.
Style/medium: consistent lush hand-painted anime fantasy art, colorful and luminous, diagonal dynamic compositions, legible single focal object in each cell.
Layout row 1, left to right:
cell 0: glowing pink sword slash.
cell 1: blue petal shield.
cell 2: red rose magical burst.
cell 3: starlit crescent magic.
Layout row 2, left to right:
cell 4: twinkling ice crystal.
cell 5: cyan lightning.
cell 6: emerald potion bottle.
cell 7: swirling poison ivy.
Layout row 3, left to right:
cell 8: amber alchemical explosion.
cell 9: luminous healing flower.
cell 10: winged boots with motion.
cell 11: gilded wishing star.
Constraints: exact four-column three-row equal cell layout; twelve distinct images in this precise reading order. Full bleed art within every tile. Each focal object should remain within its assigned cell. No text, letters, numbers, symbols used as writing, card border, captions, grid lines, watermarks, interface, presentation mockup or outer margin.
